summary: Approved after adversarial probes drove exact-main, lowercase-path, canonical-identity, bounded-file, filesystem-indirection, and rolling-review trigger hardening; the dormant contract and its focused CI line are ready to land.

findings.summary: Arbitrary target branches were replaced by an exact main-branch contract with regression coverage.
Case-ambiguous workflow paths and noncanonical context or matrix identities now fail closed.
The loader now rejects oversized, non-regular, unstable, symlinked, or reparse-point inventory paths.
Surrogate, separator, nonbreaking-space, control, format, and non-NFC context identities now fail closed.
The live v1 rolling-review gate now recognizes Garnet policy scripts and GitHub workflow, ruleset, and action paths as trust-kernel changes.
Git change enumeration disables rename detection so moving a trust path outside its prefix still exposes the protected deletion.

limitations: The Ubuntu agent-contracts run must execute the symlink regression without a skip before merge; this Windows account lacks symlink privilege.

This slice is intentionally dormant until the scanner, evaluator, inventory, and integration land; later activation must use a quiescent base-controlled checkout because Windows lacks O_NOFOLLOW and hardlinks remain an accepted filesystem representation.
